name: Frontier Colony & Border March
description: Send five hundred pioneer families to settle a fertile wilderness valley and build a fortified colony.
creativePrompt: What land grants and tax exemptions were promised to pioneers willing to brave the untamed border?
exampleNarrative: Caravans of covered ox-carts rolled into the virgin river valley, raising stone cottages where wolves once hunted.

name: Maritime Trade Island Colony
description: Dispatch an armada across the ocean to claim a strategic archipelago and establish a naval trading port.
creativePrompt: What valuable spices, pearls, or timbers make this remote island colony worth defending against pirates?
exampleNarrative: A fleet of three-masted ships dropped anchor in the turquoise bay, raising the royal standard over the island settlement.

name: River Valley Agricultural Annexation
description: Incorporate fertile downstream farmlands into the national realm with irrigation canals and tax collectors.
creativePrompt: How did the original valley dwellers react to being folded into the larger realm?
exampleNarrative: Imperial surveyors marked boundary stones along the river basin, granting royal protection in exchange for tithes of barley.

name: Fortified Border March & Castles
description: Construct a continuous chain of stone fortlets and beacon towers securing the realm against invasion.
creativePrompt: Which legendary Marcher Lord commands this frontier? What raids test their vigilance?
exampleNarrative: From hill to hill, beacon towers maintained an unbroken line of sight, ready to summon ten thousand spears in an hour.

name: Caravansary Trade Post Network
description: Erect walled fortified caravansaries spaced a day march apart along major trans-continental desert trade routes.
creativePrompt: What water cisterns and camel stables sustain the merchants during the scorching dry season?
exampleNarrative: High mudbrick walls and deep water cisterns welcomed desert caravans after weeks of blistering trek across the dune sea.

name: Peaceful Federation Integration
description: Offer full citizenship, religious protection, and market access to assimilate neighboring tribes peacefully.
creativePrompt: What seats were granted to the tribal elders in the high council? What traditions were preserved?
exampleNarrative: Without a spear cast in anger, the mountain clans swore allegiance in return for shared laws and trading charters.

name: Imperial Province Conquest & Tribute
description: Subjugate a rival province through overwhelming military force and establish an imperial viceroyalty.
creativePrompt: What annual tribute in silver, grain, or soldiers must the conquered province provide?
exampleNarrative: The vanquished rulers laid their crowns at the feet of the victorious emperor, accepting an imperial governor and garrison.

name: Dimensional Bridgehead & Sky-Colony
description: Anchor a permanent portal bridge to an orbiting moonlet or lush pocket plane, founding an extra-planar colony.
creativePrompt: What miraculous vegetation and strange skies await colonists beyond the portal threshold?
exampleNarrative: Through the shimmering gateway of silver light, pioneer skyships sailed onto the violet shores of the floating moonlet.
